problem: fixture_id and permitted_use are caller-supplied strings with no frozen trusted-context derivation law
the authority permits both SOURCE_FREE_C1_01_COMPATIBILITY and SOURCE_FREE_N10E_LIFECYCLE but the contract does not map each load-bearing call site to exactly one required token
AT07_FIXTURE_ONLY is checked as a static snapshot value; no exact invocation fixture/effective-context witness is required
the current N10E provider request carries release/source/query/model-rule determinants but no fixture_id, permitted_use or fixture-effective-context determinant
named_defect.bypass_shape: A later implementation can satisfy the validator by passing an allowed literal without proving that the actual invocation belongs to that allowed fixture/use context.
named_defect.split_review: Generic require_positive_authority plus a kind-specific validator is architecturally sufficient in principle, but the R2 kind-specific contract is not yet sufficient because its additional dimensions are not bound to trusted use-site context.
named_defect.required_correction: Freeze exact context provenance and exact call-site-to-permitted-use mapping, then require the kind-specific validator to compare authority scope to that bound context before construction/provider use.
